title: AION 2 Monetization: Quna, Membership and Costs
description: Understand AION 2 Quna uses, purchases and Kina exchange, membership trading access, free play, paid progression and Founder cosmetic restrictions.
summary: Separate free access, trading membership, Quna purchases and character passes. Check one-time Founder rewards and the pending account-wide cosmetic change.
quickAnswer: Global public access is free-to-play. Quna buys shop items, the premium pass or Kina through the player Exchange. Market and Exchange require membership. Paid progression rewards and cosmetics have different effects.

workflow.title: Decide what a payment gives you
workflow.caption: Separate base access, currency, trading membership, and character-specific offers before checkout.

steps.label: Check basic access
steps.description: The public-launch base game is free-to-play. Advance Access is a separate entitlement.

steps.label: Identify the currency
steps.description: Kina is earned through play; Quna is premium currency and can also be obtained through the player Exchange.

steps.label: Check the trading route
steps.description: Market purchases use Kina. The Kina–Quna Exchange and Market require active membership.

steps.label: Read duration and scope
steps.description: Check included membership days and pack contents; the Battle Pass is per character.

steps.label: Confirm the local amount
steps.description: Check your local storefront currency and final price, then compare the current player exchange offer.
